<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Example Stripe Gateway
 */
// A payment plugin names its own settings; it never reads wp-config.php as
// text or looks for a .env. F22 must stay quiet.
class Example_Stripe_Gateway {
	public function keys() {
		$settings = get_option( 'woocommerce_stripe_settings', array() );
		return array( $settings['publishable_key'] ?? '', $settings['secret_key'] ?? '' );
	}
	public function mode() {
		return defined( 'EXAMPLE_STRIPE_TEST_MODE' ) ? 'test' : 'live';
	}
}
